triage.title: Crew triage
triage.subtitle: Works without Earth · START rules + voice
triage.activateBody: Classify each crewmember's severity, prioritize who to treat and send the report to Earth when the link allows. It does not diagnose or prescribe.
triage.deviceMode: Emergency without session: registered tablet. Grants access to triage only.
triage.noAccessBody: Without a session, triage only opens on tablets registered by mission control or the commander. You can send a basic SOS.
triage.linkDown: No link right now: the report is queued and goes out as soon as signal returns.
triage.reportSentBody: It will reach Earth after the link delay.
triage.reportInTransit: Latest report in transit · arrives in {{eta}}.
triage.closeHint: Hold 2.5 s to close. If no report was sent, one is sent on closing.
triage.closedBody: Saved to history and reported to Earth.
triage.voiceStart: Triage activated. Assess each crewmember. Answer yes or no.
triage.observableOnly: Not responding: only observable signs are used.
triage.upgradedByRadiation: Priority raised due to early vomiting after radiation exposure.
triage.outOfProtocolPlaceholder: Describe what you see (injury, symptom, context)…

deadMan.title: Are you still there?
deadMan.body: Tap the button. If nobody responds within {{seconds}} s, the report is sent to Earth and the crew is alerted.
deadMan.voice: Are you still there? Tap the screen.
deadMan.firedBody: Nobody responded: the report was sent to Earth and the crew was alerted.
deadMan.firedVoice: No response. Report sent to Earth and crew alerted.

report.footer: Generated on board by versioned rules. Not a diagnosis.
report.mcBody_one: Active triage with {{count}} crewmember assessed. Medical detail sent to the flight surgeon.
report.mcBody_other: Active triage with {{count}} crewmembers assessed. Medical detail sent to the flight surgeon.
